intro: Choose what Atlas tells you about, and where. Each switch saves straight away.
matrixNote: Everything you’re told about also stays in the list behind the bell. Turn all three off and Atlas doesn’t record that event.

ev.news_alert: News on a position you hold

desc.proposal_awaiting_approval: When a trade passes the risk engine and needs your yes or no.
desc.circuit_breaker: When a loss limit, a losing streak, OKX errors or a sharp move pauses trading.
desc.kill_switch: When Stop trading runs: what it cancelled, kept and closed.
desc.reconciliation_mismatch: When Atlas’s records didn’t match OKX and were corrected.
desc.order_filled: When an order Atlas placed fills on OKX.
desc.stop_hit: When OKX triggers one of your stop-losses.
desc.news_alert: When News Intelligence flags an important story on something you hold.
desc.agent_degraded: When an agent stops working or reaches its Claude usage limit.
desc.data_stale: When prices stop updating and new trades pause.
desc.daily_report: When the Portfolio Manager posts the day’s report, at 23:30.

tg.title: Telegram
tg.intro: Get notifications on your phone from a bot only you control.
tg.s1: In Telegram, open a chat with @BotFather and send /newbot. Answer its two questions; it replies with your bot’s token.
tg.s2: Open your new bot and press Start, so it can write to you.
tg.s3: Message @userinfobot. It replies with your chat ID, a number like 987654321.
tg.tokenHint: Kept encrypted on this Mac. Atlas shows only its last 4 characters.

e.token: That doesn’t look like a bot token. It’s a number and a code joined by a colon, like 123456789:AAH…
e.chat: A chat ID is a number, like 987654321. Group chats start with a minus sign.
e.server: Couldn’t save the bot. Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so nothing changed. Try again.

tg.testOkBody: It should be in your Telegram chat now.
tg.testFailTitle: Telegram didn’t accept the test message
tg.testFailBody: Check the token, and press Start in your bot’s chat so it can write to you. Telegram said:
tg.savedBody: Nothing goes there until you turn on its switches above. Waiting trades come with Approve and Reject.
tg.useNeeds: Send the 4 “Needs you” events to Telegram
tg.usedNeeds: Telegram is on for the 4 “Needs you” events
tg.note: Approve and Reject in Telegram act for you, like pressing them in Atlas. Keep the bot’s chat private.
tg.rpText: Enter a token and chat ID. Atlas keeps the current bot until the new one is saved.
tg.rmText: Atlas stops sending to Telegram, and Approve and Reject in messages already sent stop working. Your Telegram switches are kept for when you set it up again.
tg.rmToastBody: Nothing is sent to Telegram now.
tg.savedToastBody: Bot {{last4}}. Send a test message to check it.

t.saveFailBody: {{event}} is back as it was. Atlas’s server didn’t answer.

err.title: Couldn’t load notification settings
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
